facts: Parties: Northgate Media Ltd (Buyer), Juniper Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Thornbury Robotics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 16 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 September 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $2,880,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $23,760,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Holloway Energy plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
